en: A colored vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a monastery complex in a river valley surrounded by steep rock cliffs and forested hills. Fields stretch across the valley floor, and a river meanders along the right side. In the foreground is the large monastery with a church tower and multiple buildings arranged around courtyards. Decorative handwritten script covers the lower portion. Printed text in German appears on the image margins and at the bottom.
